title: Dispatch: olc5.13 table-defined charge loss on item_state_event + atomic effect gate + self-loop timer preservation (attempt 1)
description:
Implements capability eshyra-olc5.13 (read it: description, ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA, notes; parent eshyra-olc5 capability contract; bd recall magic-item-faithful-or-absent). Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md for the importer part. Branch eshyra-olc5.13.1 cut from eshyra-olc5.13 (cut SHA recorded at dispatch; includes olc5.12 if merged).

CODE SURVEY (verified by captain on origin/main 339487f1):
- Tool: packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolItemStateEvent.ts (inputs instanceId, condition, character; calls applyItemStateConditionEvent).
- Executor: packages/core/src/state/itemResetExecutor.ts applyItemStateConditionEvent (~L403). Today it matches exactly one transition from the current state by exact condition, DROPS pending timers whose from == current state, schedules timers declared from the target state, fires the 'state-entered' cooldown anchor for the target, and writes. It never looks at transition.effects, so effect-bearing condition events "succeed" without executing their effect (PR #663 review P2), and a self-loop restarts timers (re-anchors the Cube 1-minute barrier).
- Pack authoring: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts, Cube of Force entry (~L238): effect procedure('m5-complex-cube-contact', trigger, 'deduct the source-defined charges', { tableRef: 'table:cube-of-force-charges-lost' }). Effect kind is triggeredEffect; schema in packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts (~L3435, triggeredEffect: trigger/result/condition only).
- Pack data: magic-item:cube-of-force economies.charges {max 36, reset dawn 1d20}; face-1..face-5 each have condition self-loop (condition = "The cube loses charges when the barrier is targeted by certain spells or comes into contact with certain spell or magic item effects, as shown in the table below.", effects ['m5-complex-cube-contact']), timer transition face-N -> inactive {1 minute}, condition transition face-N -> inactive "the cube runs out of charges". table:cube-of-force-charges-lost columns ["Spell or Item","Charges Lost"], rows Disintegrate 1d12, Horn of blasting 1d10, Passwall 1d6, Prismatic spray 1d20, Wall of fire 1d4. These five Cube self-loops are the ONLY effect-bearing condition transitions in the pack (captain enumerated).
- Immovable Rod: active -> active condition "A creature can use an action to make a DC 30 Strength check, moving the fixed rod up to 10 feet on a success." (effectless self-loop).
- Existing tests: packages/core/test/itemResetExecutor.test.ts (applyItemStateConditionEvent cases ~L160-300), tools.test.ts, srdGeneratedPack.test.ts.

CAPTAIN DESIGN (follow; if any part is wrong or the pack is insufficient, STOP and report in notes rather than improvising):
1. Explicit pack contract. Add an optional typed field to the triggeredEffect schema: economyDeduction: { economy: string, tableRef: string, keyColumn: string, amountColumn: string } (exact keys, all required when present; validate economy exists in the item's economies, tableRef equals the effect's tableRef, both columns exist in that table, and every amountColumn cell parses as a dice expression or non-negative integer - validate where the item/table cross-references are validated, fail the pack load otherwise). Author it ONLY on m5-complex-cube-contact: { economy: 'charges', tableRef: 'table:cube-of-force-charges-lost', keyColumn: 'Spell or Item', amountColumn: 'Charges Lost' }. Regenerate the pack with the repo's script and commit the output. Do not derive this from prose anywhere else.
2. Tool input. item_state_event gains optional tableRow (string): the exact keyColumn value of one row in the deduction table (e.g. 'Disintegrate'). Matching is exact string equality; on no match refuse and list the valid row keys in the error. tableRow is REQUIRED when the matched transition carries an economyDeduction effect and REFUSED (error, no change) when the transition has none. Tool description: DM decides that the barrier was targeted/contacted and which listed spell or item did it; unlisted spells/effects cause no charge loss and must not be sent.
3. Executable-effects gate (atomic). Before any write: for the matched transition, every effect id in transition.effects must resolve in mechanics.effects AND be executable; today the only executable effect is a triggeredEffect carrying a valid economyDeduction. Any other effect -> throw ItemResetExecutorError (whole transaction refused: no state, economy, timer or anchor change, no success result). Effectless condition transitions keep working exactly as now.
4. Deduction. Roll the row's amount with the campaign rng passed in (ctx.rng); if rng is absent for a dice amount, refuse. Deduct min(rolled, current remaining) from the economy (never below 0) through the existing economy state helpers/validators (find how use_item/charge spend writes economies in itemState.ts and reuse them, do not hand-roll a parallel writer). No action/turn-resource/owner cost is recorded. Result adds { deduction: { economy, tableRow, amount (rolled), deducted, remaining } }.
5. Running out. Do NOT auto-apply "the cube runs out of charges"; that condition is free text with no typed binding. When remaining reaches 0, return exhausted: true and the tool description tells the DM to then send item_state_event with condition "the cube runs out of charges". Note it as residual DM interpretation in completion notes.
6. Self-loops. When transition.from === transition.to, preserve pendingTimers unchanged (do not drop or reschedule) and do not fire the 'state-entered' cooldown anchor, because no condition self-loop in the pack carries an explicit reset authorization. (Leave via/use_item self-loops with resetsDuration source-ambiguity untouched - owned by campaign ruling, not this bead.) Non-self-loop condition transitions keep current behaviour.
7. Readiness. Do not land shared hooks (F5 'complex item state and duration processing', F9 geometry) unless fully owned for every carrier; Cube barrier geometry is not. Report the exact ready-operation delta (deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady before/after; expected likely zero) in notes.

CONFORMANCE TESTS (generated pack records, permanent evidence per AGENTS.md "Permanent Test Evidence"):
- Cube of Force at face-1 with a pending 1-minute timer: condition event + tableRow 'Disintegrate' with seeded rng deducts the rolled 1d12 (clamped), state stays face-1, pending timer dueAt UNCHANGED, no turn resource touched.
- Unknown tableRow, missing tableRow, and dice-amount without rng each refuse with state, charges and timers byte-identical to before.
- Deduction larger than remaining clamps to 0 and returns exhausted: true; subsequent "the cube runs out of charges" event moves to inactive.
- Immovable Rod DC 30 self-loop: succeeds without tableRow, preserves state/timers/anchors; supplying tableRow is refused.
- An effect-bearing condition transition whose effect is not executable (test fixture record, not the SRD pack) is refused atomically.
- Pack validation rejects a malformed economyDeduction (unknown economy, column missing, unparseable amount).

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: contract, input semantics, self-loop rule, residual DM interpretation, ready delta, verify result.
notes:
Dispatched 2026-10-15 as Claude Haiku 5.5 Agent subagent. Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-olc5.13.1; branch cut from eshyra-olc5.13 = eshyra-olc5.12 @ b205724d (stacked on PR #665, under Sol review; olc5.12 added item grants and the Efreeti remove-stopper op, regenerated pack). Captain: the effect-bearing condition transitions are still only the five Cube of Force self-loops on this base; re-check after your changes.
COMPLETION REPORT (Haiku 5.5 dispatch, attempt 1). Commit c1b8a417 on eshyra-olc5.13.1 (base b205724d). verify:worktree exit 0 (364 files passed, 2 skipped; 6816 tests passed, 3 skipped). verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exit 0.

CONTRACT: triggeredEffect gains optional economyDeduction {economy, tableRef, keyColumn, amountColumn}; shape validated in kindSchemas (tableRef must equal the effect tableRef). Pack-wide validate.ts checks economy exists on the same mechanics, table exists, both columns exist, keys unique, every amount cell is a non-negative integer or a dice expression (parseDice). Authored only on m5-complex-cube-contact. Pack regenerated; the only records.json diff is that effect.

INPUT: item_state_event tableRow (exact keyColumn match). Required when the matched transition has a deduction, refused otherwise. Unknown or missing row refuses and lists valid rows.

GATE: every effect id on the matched transition must resolve and be a triggeredEffect with economyDeduction (max one). Otherwise refuse with no write. Effectless condition events unchanged.

DEDUCTION: rolls the cell via ctx rng (refuses dice without rng), deducts min(rolled, remaining), never below 0. Writes through validateItemStateForRecord and writeItemState. No action, turn-resource, or owner cost. Result adds deduction {economy, tableRow, amount, deducted, remaining}; exhausted: true only when remaining hits 0.

SELF-LOOP: from==to preserves pendingTimers and skips the state-entered cooldown anchor. Non-self-loop path unchanged (validate, anchor, validate).

RESIDUAL DM INTERPRETATION: 'the cube runs out of charges' is not auto-applied; DM sends it after exhausted:true. DM decides targeting/contact and the listed spell or item; unlisted effects must not be sent. Deduction does not call scheduleEconomyAfterSpend or depletion resolution (Cube reset is dawn; no depletion declared).

READY DELTA: deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady over 462 item/variant/operation combinations in the committed pack: 13 ready before, 13 after, 0 changed. Cube press ops are not readiness-green.

DEVIATIONS (captain design): (1) economy-existence check moved from magicItemMechanics per-mechanics validator to pack-wide validate.ts. The per-projection importer test validates the effect without sibling economies and failed. (2) Added a classifier rule in inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts for economyDeduction.* (complete, consumer = item_state_event executor). Without it the conservative fallback recorded 'no deterministic consumer', which became false. Regenerated docs/inventories o9bd-18-8-8 json and md (1854 to 1858 rows); the inventory test compares them byte for byte. (3) Test fixture for Cube pack includes the referenced table in the rules stack, as a campaign stack does.

TESTS (permanent, itemResetExecutor.test.ts, 9 new cases): Cube face-1 deduction with seeded rng, timer dueAt unchanged; unknown/missing/no-rng refusals byte-identical raw state; clamp to 0, exhausted, then runs-out transition; Immovable Rod DC30 self-loop without tableRow preserves state and timers and refuses tableRow; non-executable effect refused atomically; pack validation accepts the committed Cube and rejects unknown economy, missing or wrong column, tableRef mismatch, extra key, unparseable amount, negative amount.

NOT DONE: nothing required. No push, no beads:sync, no PR, no merge.
